materialRecords.vertexShader:
varying vec3 vDir;
      void main() { vDir = position; vec4 p = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * p; gl_Position.z = gl_Position.w * 0.99999; }
varying vec3 vW; void main() { vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); vW = wp.xyz; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }
varying vec3 vW; void main() { vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); vW = wp.xyz; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }
varying vec2 vUv; void main() { vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }

materialRecords.fragmentShader: varying vec4 vCol; void main() { vec2 c = gl_PointCoord - 0.5; float r = length(c) * 2.0; float a = smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, r); gl_FragColor = vec4(vCol.rgb * (a * a + 0.6 * smoothstep(0.35, 0.0, r)), vCol.a); }

materialRecords.vertexShader:
attribute float aT; varying float vT; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vW;
      void main() { vT = aT; vN = normal; vW = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }

materialRecords.fragmentShader:
uniform vec3 uColor; varying float vA;
      void main() { if (vA < 0.004) discard; vec2 c = gl_PointCoord - 0.5; float a = smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, length(c)) * vA; gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor, a); }

materialRecords.vertexShader: varying vec3 vW; varying vec2 vC; void main(){ vC = uv * 2.0 - 1.0; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); vW = w.xyz; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }

materialRecords.fragmentShader:
uniform vec3 uColor; varying float vA;
      void main() { if (vA < 0.004) discard; vec2 c = gl_PointCoord - 0.5; float a = smoothstep(0.5, 0.05, length(c)) * vA; gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor, a); }
